item.description:
### Added - **Finder Enhancer** — move files in Finder with `⌘ X` → `⌘ V`, open selected items with `Return` (or rename with `F2`), and optionally auto-quit allowlisted or non-excluded apps after their last window closes - **Clipboard Image History** — capture screenshots and copied images with thumbnails, filters, pinning, instant paste, Save As export, and configurable local cache limits
### Changed - **Clipboard** — after deleting an item, the highlight moves to the item below it (or above it) instead of jumping back to the top of the list
### Fixed - **Status Bar** — the "Toolbox (Active)" tooltip no longer lingers away from the menu bar; the icon and popover header now show the Active/Paused state - **Window Snapper** — locking or letting displays sleep no longer re-applies the auto profile or flashes a loading toast, and turning it on at startup no longer re-applies unchanged display setups
